setup: Captured from the headless emulator ot_emu in MKII mode, booted on a development twin of a Modwerk base built from this repository's main at 633ff3e9e (imageSha256 is that twin's MAIN image), with the Grain 0.1.2-experimental package built in the pinned toolchain installed through the development session. Each picture is the emulator's framebuffer read by the session's png step: 128x64 at integer scale 2 (256x128), converted to two grey levels in an 8-bit greyscale PNG, not edited otherwise. See each image. Not hardware captures.
